rows.definition: HIL ComparisonScope value declaring an engine or optimization comparison on the same named hardware, used to admit a descriptive ratio only when both producer-reported arms have compatible dimensions.
rows.distinction: ComparisonEngine is a comparison-attribution discriminator, not the Engine inference execution driver. It requires the same named hardware; ComparisonHardware instead compares hardware targets without engine attribution. Structural ratio admission grants neither verified physical execution nor achieved-win credit.
